- [illustration.providers.pexels](_autosummary/illustration.providers.pexels.html.md): Pexels source — high-quality stock photos, &#42;&#42;API key required&#42;&#42;.
- [illustration.providers.pixabay](_autosummary/illustration.providers.pixabay.html.md): Pixabay source — free commercial-use images, &#42;&#42;API key required (query param)&#42;&#42;.
- [illustration.providers.wikimedia](_autosummary/illustration.providers.wikimedia.html.md): Wikimedia Commons source — 140M+ free media, &#42;&#42;no key&#42;&#42;, deep file metadata.
- [illustration.registry](_autosummary/illustration.registry.html.md): The open-closed source registry and the &#96;sources&#96; view.
- [illustration.reranking](_autosummary/illustration.reranking.html.md): Local cross-modal rerank — the precision stage (research report R1 §3).
- [illustration.schema](_autosummary/illustration.schema.html.md): The normalized result schema — the single source of truth (Pydantic v2).
- [illustration.schema_export](_autosummary/illustration.schema_export.html.md): Export the Python SSOT as committed JSON for the TypeScript twin (&#96;ts/&#96;).
- [illustration.sequence](_autosummary/illustration.sequence.html.md): Sequence-level selection — the M4 domain core (research report R2 §5).
- [illustration.translation](_autosummary/illustration.translation.html.md): Canonical → native parameter translation (the &#96;denote&#96; &#96;param_map&#96; idiom).
- [illustration.video](_autosummary/illustration.video.html.md): Narration → Ken-Burns video hook — the M4 integration seam.
